I will put manure on this plot before ploughing, and I will apply DAP and urea from the cooperative — roughly 35 kg of nitrogen per hectare worth — because maize needs food to grow well on my small piece of land. I use improved seed saved from last season, and I do not buy pesticides or irrigate since this land depends on rainfall and weeding by hand. My family will work about 15 days here over the season, planting, weeding, and harvesting together, so I do not need to hire anyone.
